integrity: The mathematical derivation and finite verification were reviewed in the same review phase; the finite tests are not used as a proof of all-size claims. Historical priority may be affected by inaccessible primary full text.
limitations: Fixed finite connected complete bipartite adjacency networks, homogeneous hopping, a single trap, positive dephasing on nontrap sites, fixed finite-dimensional weak-noise limit. No large-network uniformity, arbitrary disordered graph, or finite-time distribution.
title: Partition-selective weak-dephasing clock on trapped complete bipartite quantum networks
